(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; const score = document.querySelector('.text-4xl'); const statBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button.stat')); const statTitles = statBtns.map(b => (b.querySelector('.stat-title')?.textContent || '') + '=' + (b.querySelector('.stat-value')?.textContent || '')); const runBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li')).filter(li => li.querySelector('code')).map(li => li.querySelector('code').textContent); const nav = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(a => (a.textContent||'').includes('AI Controller')); const btn = document.querySelector('button'); const theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme'); const font = getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily; return JSON.stringify({ heading: t.includes('AI Controller'), phase: t.includes('Phase 5.0'), score: score ? score.textContent : null, label: t.includes('Degraded') ? 'Degraded' : t.includes('Healthy') ? 'Healthy' : 'other', namesDarkSite: t.includes('dark-site'), deadLetterFinding: t.includes('Dead-lettered tasks'), recommendedReenqueue: t.includes('re-enqueue-deadletters'), statCards: statTitles, actionButtons: runBtns, navEntry: nav, cursor: btn ? getComputedStyle(btn).cursor : 'n/a', theme: theme, fontHasGeist: font.includes('Geist') }); })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('button[title="Show critical findings"]'); if (!b) return 'no crit card'; b.click(); return 'crit card clicked'; })()

(() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded]')); const list = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li')).filter(li => li.querySelector('.badge')); return 'expandedRows=' + rows.filter(r => r.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true').length + ';critRows=' + list.filter(li => (li.querySelector('.badge')?.textContent||'').includes('Critical')).length; })()
(() => { const b = document.querySelector('button[title="Show critical findings"]'); if (!b) return 'no card'; b.click(); return 'reset to all'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-expanded]')).find(b => (b.textContent||'').includes('Dead-lettered')); if (!row) return 'no finding row'; row.click(); return 'finding expanded'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'detailVisible=' + t.includes('failed terminally and are waiting'); })()

(() => { const li = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('li')).find(x => x.querySelector('code')?.textContent === 'reprobe-mesh'); const b = li ? li.querySelector('button') : null; if (!b) return 'no run btn'; b.click(); return 'run clicked'; })()
